name: [D1] Separate capability metrics from workflow-session reports (M)
description:
Separate capability metrics from workflow-session reports

Location: src/ovcaq/workflow/reports.py; tests/workflow/test_canonical_metrics.py

Reuse: existing StateStore/StateService, pure decisions, shared runtime ownership and test fixtures.

Contract (source requirement/design excerpts):
For `kind="phase"`, `phase_launched` and `model` are required and
`capability` is null. For `kind="capability"`, `capability` is required while
phase/model are null.
The tolerant legacy report loader continues to accept characterized legacy rows.

Details:
Replace the hidden usage-filter comprehension with an explicit canonical projection that retains legacy compatibility and makes invalid usage observable instead of silently dropping a row. Treat canonical kind=capability rows distinctly from phase sessions so capability attempts do not inflate workflow session counts or turn otherwise known phase usage totals unknown. Preserve capability raw/canonical metrics and deterministic batch filtering. Cover mixed legacy, phase, capability and malformed usage rows with behavior assertions.

### Findings (verbatim)
- 🟡 Reports count capability metric rows as workflow sessions. Canonical rows always carry `phase_launched` (None for capabilities) and `_metric_partitions` selects sessions by key presence. One capability attempt therefore inflates the session count and turns batch cost/token totals to unknown. No test covers it (test_canonical_metrics only has phase rows) | File: src/ovcaq/workflow/reports.py:222 | Consensus: [1/3]
- 🟡 `_metric_partitions` silently drops any row whose `usage` is not a Mapping, using a `for usage in [...] if isinstance(...)` comprehension trick. That swallows an error and is hard to read | File: src/ovcaq/workflow/reports.py:217 | Consensus: [1/3]

Acceptance criteria:
- Every quoted finding no longer reproduces.
- Every decision is explainable from committed state plus summary.
- Metrics, pause, stop, retry, park, and halt contracts pass.
- Required post-drain capability lifecycle and independent retry pass.

Verify: tests fail for the quoted regression before implementation and pass after; run applicable focused tests, source quality gates, and the work skill's mandatory final verification. Do not read live launcher homes in tests.
